name: How are felony sentences determined in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How are felony sentences determined in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sentencing depends on the felony type, defendant’s criminal history, and mitigating or aggravating factors; California’s Three Strikes Law can increase penalties for repeat offenders.sandiegocriminalattorneys+1​
